pages.name: Slav: Winawer Countergambit Accepted, 6.Bd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported d4 with ...f5; plan 2 harassed the queen with Nb3, a move no knight can make; plan 3 fianchettoed the light-squared bishop to g7. Rewrote plans 1-3 around ...Qxe5, Nf3/g3/e3 and ...Bf5/...Nd7. British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: 3.Nf3 Bg4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn blocks it); plan 1 wrote Black's Bxf3 into a White sequence. Rewrote the overview and plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Slav: 3.Nf3 dxc4 4.e3 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 1 chased the e6-bishop with Na4; plan 2 played ...e6 and ...Be7 with the bishop on e6 and the e-pawn at home (first rewrite with ...g6/...Bg7 rejected as unconfirmed; simplified and re-accepted); plan 3 attacked a d5-pawn that has gone. British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 called ...Bg4 a pin and said ...Bxf3 damages White's structure (the g2-bishop can recapture); plan 1 wrote gxf3 and an open g-file. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the d2-knight via f1, where the rook stands; plan 4 called ...Bg4 a pin and ...Bxf3 structural damage, though the d2-knight recaptures. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Plan 2 named g4 onto the bishop's square; plan 3 named White's e4 in a Black plan; plan 4 called ...a6/...b5 a minority attack. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the d2-knight via f1, where the rook stands; plan 2 called ...Bg4 a pin. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a knight ...Nf6-d7-f8 to stop e4, which makes no sense here. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a b4-b5 minority attack the structure does not allow; plan 3 gave an Nc3-e1-d3 route; plan 4 wrote the pawn triangle as a route and named Nh4 in a Black plan. Rewrote the overview's ...h6 sentence and plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Slav-Reti System
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported e4 with Qe2 while the e2-pawn stands there; plan 3 was vague; plan 4 routed the d2-knight via f1, where the rook stands. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.
